svg.title: Weight loss by menopause stage on tirzepatide and CagriSema
svg.desc: Average weight loss by menopause stage in two big trials, women only, assigned to a stage after the fact mostly by age. Tirzepatide (Zepbound) in SURMOUNT-1: 26%, 23% and 23% before, during and after menopause, vs 2-3% on placebo. CagriSema in REDEFINE 1: 26.7%, 24.8% and 23.1%, vs 1.7-2.6% on placebo; women on hormone therapy (any age): 25.6% vs 2.3%. The two trials are separate and should not be compared head to head.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: After menopause: 3 to 4 points less, still over 20%
